newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Eregli begins $190 mln investments.
newsitem.headline: Turk Eregli begins $190 mln investments.

text.p: Turkey's biggest flat steel producer, largely state-owned Eregli Demir ve Celik Fabrikalari A.S., has begun a $190 million programme to lower production costs, increase quality and introduce products with more added value, the Anatolian new agency quoted general manager Isk Eyupoglu as saying.
The latest scheme is in addition to the $1.5 billion KAM scheme which was launched in 1989 to raise annual output capacity to 3.3 million tonnes from 1.5 million. KAM is now almost complete.
The company had said in March the 1997 investment spending as part of KAM would be $88.6 million.
Eyupoglu said Eregli also finished feasibility studies to start in 1998 a new stage of the KAM project to increase output to 4.5 million tonnes after the year 2000.
Eregli's flat steel output reached a record high of 2,621,000 tonnes in 1996, compared to 1,633,000 tonnes in 1995 and the previous record of 2,115,000 in 1994.
Its domestic market share went up to 18.3 percent in 1996 from 16 percent a year ago.
